title: Turns out my Mall World is based off a mall I used to go to as a child.
content: Someone recently posted a few pictures of a mall that I used to go to years ago, now with only 3 open shops. I’ve never seen it so empty like this in person, but it’s exactly like this in my dreams. Does anyone else travel to a mall they’ve actually been to? It felt really weird to randomly see the pictures pop up in my feed!
